target.title: Preview channel plugin blocker dry-run effects
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`doctor fix --dry-run --only core/doctor/channel-plugin-blockers` could detect configured channels whose backing plugins are not loadable, but it did not return any structured repair/effect metadata. That made this merged Doctor rule family weaker than the other dry-run backfills even though the correct outcome is an explicit operator action rather than an automatic config rewrite.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a narrow dry-run repair effect for channel plugin blocker findings. The effect previews the required activation work as `would-require-channel-plugin-activation` and keeps real repair skipped because Doctor should not silently mutate plugin enablement/trust config from this finding.

Session locks and config-audit scrub were audited on current `main` while preparing this slice; both already have structured dry-run effects, so this PR only covers the remaining missing merged area from the backfill list.

## User Impact

Users running Doctor dry-run repair previews get a visible effect for channel/plugin blocker findings instead of a detect-only result. Existing lint defaults, plugin activation behavior, and startup channel maintenance behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

Proof on head `8bfdd86f37`:

- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor/shared/channel-plugin-blockers.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/channel-plugin-blockers.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/commands/doctor/shared/channel-plugin-blockers.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/channel-plugin-blockers.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor/shared/channel-plugin-blockers.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo`
- `git diff --check`
